summary: SQL Injection in Login Endpoint (Auth Bypass) @ http://127.0.0.1:3010/rest/user/login

data.observation: Proof: POST /rest/user/login with body {"email":"' OR 1=1 --","password":"test"} returns HTTP 200 with JSON containing token, bid, and email fields. In contrast, invalid credentials return HTTP 401 with {"error":"Invalid email or password"}. This demonstrates SQL injection authentication bypass. The SQLi payload causes the query to return the first user (admin) regardless of password.
